role.label: Entity Current Reporting Status
role.documentation: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' whether registrants (1) have filed all reports required to be filed by Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 during the preceding 12 months (or for such shorter period that registrants were required to file such reports), and (2) have been subject to such filing requirements for the past 90 days. This information should be based on the registrant's current or most recent filing containing the related disclosure.

role.label: Entity [Domain]
role.documentation: All the names of the entities being reported upon in a document. Any legal structure used to conduct activities or to hold assets. role.label: Entity Emerging Growth Company

role.documentation: Indicate whether the registrant is one of the following: Large Accelerated Filer, Accelerated Filer, Non-accelerated Filer. role.terseLabel: Entity Incorporation, State or Country Code
role.label: Entity Incorporation, State or Country Code

role.label: Entity Interactive Data Current

role.label: Entity Public Float
role.documentation: The aggregate market value of the voting and non-voting common equity held by non-affiliates computed by reference to the price at which the common equity was last sold, or the average bid and asked price of such common equity, as of the last business day of the registrant's most recently completed second fiscal quarter.

role.label: Entity Registrant Name
role.documentation: The exact name of the entity filing the report as specified in its charter, which is required by forms filed with the SEC.

role.label: Entity Shell Company
role.documentation: Boolean flag that is true when the registrant is a shell company as defined in Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act.

role.label: Entity Small Business
role.documentation: Indicates that the company is a Smaller Reporting Company (SRC).

role.label: Entity Tax Identification Number
role.documentation: The Tax Identification Number (TIN), also known as an Employer Identification Number (EIN), is a unique 9-digit value assigned by the IRS.

role.label: Entity Voluntary Filers
role.documentation: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is not required to file reports pursuant to Section 13 or Section 15(d) of the Act.

role.label: Entity Well-known Seasoned Issuer
role.documentation: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is a well-known seasoned issuer, as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act. Is used on Form Type: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 6-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q/A, 20-F/A, 6-K/A, N-CSR, N-Q, N-1A.

role.documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

role.label: Gross Profit
role.documentation: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

role.label: Hedging Designation [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by designation of purpose of derivative instrument.

role.label: Hedging Designation [Domain]
role.documentation: Designation of purpose of derivative instrument.

role.label: Hedging Relationship [Domain]
role.documentation: Nature or intent of a hedge.

role.label: High Performance Capacitors [Member]
role.documentation: High Performance Capacitors

role.label: Immaterial Asset Acquisition [Member]
role.documentation: Immaterial Asset Acquisition

role.terseLabel: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Indefinite-lived (Excluding Goodwill)
role.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Indefinite-Lived (Excluding Goodwill)
role.documentation: Amount of impairment loss resulting from write-down of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit to fair value.

role.terseLabel: Imputed Interest Rate on Future Payments
role.label: Imputed Interest Rate on Future Payments
role.documentation: Imputed Interest Rate on Future Payments

role.terseLabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
role.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
role.documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.

role.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
role.documentation: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

role.terseLabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
role.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
role.documentation: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

role.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
role.documentation: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

role.terseLabel: Components of Earnings before Income Tax [Abstract]
role.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

role.terseLabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic Share
role.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic Share
role.documentation: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

role.terseLabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Diluted Share
role.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Diluted Share
role.documentation: The amount of net income (loss) derived from continuing operations during the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

role.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
role.documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the parent. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

role.terseLabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
role.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
role.documentation: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

role.label: Disposal Group Name [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by name of disposal group.

role.terseLabel: Income Statement, Balance Sheet and Additional Disclosures by Disposal Groups, Including Discontinued Operations [Line Items]
role.label: Income Statement, Balance Sheet and Additional Disclosures by Disposal Groups, Including Discontinued Operations [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Disposal Groups, Including Discontinued Operations [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about a disposal group. Includes, but is not limited to, a discontinued operation, disposal classified as held-for-sale or disposed of by means other than sale or disposal of an individually significant component.

role.label: Statement of Income Location, Balance [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by location in statement of income where disaggregated amount is reported.

role.label: Statement of Income Location, Balance [Domain]
role.documentation: Location in statement of income where disaggregated amount is reported.

role.label: Income Tax Jurisdiction [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by income tax jurisdiction.

role.label: Income Tax Jurisdiction [Domain]
role.documentation: Income tax jurisdiction.

role.label: Income Tax Authority, Name [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by name of taxing authority.

role.label: Income Tax Authority, Name [Domain]
role.documentation: Named agency, division or body that levies income taxes, examines tax returns for compliance, or grants exemptions from or makes other decisions pertaining to income taxes.

role.label: Income Tax Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for income tax.

role.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
role.documentation: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

role.label: Income Tax Holiday [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Income Tax, Holiday [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about income tax exemption and reduction granted by tax authority for specified period. Includes, but is not limited to, description of factual circumstance for income tax exemption and reduction, date when special tax status terminates, and aggregate dollar and per share effect of tax benefit from income tax exemption and reduction.

role.terseLabel: Income Tax Paid, Federal, after Refund Received
role.label: Income Tax Paid, Federal, after Refund Received
role.documentation: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

role.terseLabel: Income Tax Paid, Foreign, after Refund Received
role.label: Income Tax Paid, Foreign, after Refund Received
role.documentation: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to foreign tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

role.terseLabel: Income Tax Paid, State and Local, after Refund Received
role.label: Income Tax Paid, State and Local, after Refund Received
role.documentation: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

role.label: Income Tax, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for income taxes, which may include its accounting policies for recognizing and measuring deferred tax assets and liabilities and related valuation allowances, recognizing investment tax credits, operating loss carryforwards, tax credit carryforwards, and other carryforwards, methodologies for determining its effective income tax rate and the characterization of interest and penalties in the financial statements.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Amount
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to increase (decrease) in the income tax rates.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax expense (benefit).

role.terseLabel: Income tax expense at U.S. federal statutory income tax rate
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
role.documentation: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amortization, Amount
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amortization, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible amortization.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Impairment Losses, Amount
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Impairment Losses, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible impairment loss.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Amount
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Amount
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Reconciling Items, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation attributable to other reconciling item. Excludes state and local income tax expense (benefit), federal tax expense (benefit), statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of country of domicile, tax credit, nondeductible expense, deduction, income tax settlement, income tax contingency, and cross-border tax law.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Prior Year Income Taxes, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income tax expense (benefit).

role.terseLabel: State and local taxes, net of federal income tax benefit
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax expense (benefit).

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in income tax contingencies. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Foreign, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in foreign income tax contingency.

role.negatedTerseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Amount
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Research, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to research tax credit.

role.negatedTerseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Exempt Income, Amount
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Exempt Income, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Holiday, Percent
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Holiday, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income exempt from income tax because of a tax holiday.

role.label: Income Taxes Paid
role.documentation: Amount, before refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

role.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
role.documentation: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Taxes Payable
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of all taxes owed but not paid, including income, property and other taxes.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract Receivables, Net
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables arising from the contracting of goods and services, net for uncollectible accounts.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Employee Related Liabilities
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

role.terseLabel: Changes in assets and liabilities (excluding effects of foreign exchange):
role.label: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Increase (Decrease) in Operating Capital [Abstract]

role.negatedTerseLabel: Other non-current assets and non-current liabilities
role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets and Liabilities, Net
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating assets after deduction of noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepaid expenses, and assets classified as other.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Stockholders' Equity [Roll Forward]
role.documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

role.label: Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type or class of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit.

role.label: Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)
role.documentation: Amount of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit.

role.terseLabel: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Major Class Name [Domain]
role.label: Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets, Major Class Name [Domain]
role.documentation: The major class of indefinite-lived intangible asset (for example, trade names, etc. but not all-inclusive), excluding goodwill. A major class is composed of intangible assets that can be grouped together because they are similar, either by their nature or by their use in the operations of the company.

role.label: Indemnity Claim
role.documentation: Indemnity Claim

role.label: Insider Trading Policies and Procedures [Line Items]

role.terseLabel: Insider Trading Policies and Procedures Adopted
role.label: Insider Trading Policies and Procedures Adopted [Flag]

role.terseLabel: Insider Trading Policies and Procedures Not Adopted
role.label: Insider Trading Policies and Procedures Not Adopted [Text Block]
Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
role.documentation: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

role.label: Interest Expense, Borrowings
role.documentation: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all borrowings.

role.label: Interest Expense, Debt
role.documentation: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense for debt.

role.label: Interest Income (Expense), Operating
role.documentation: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating.

role.label: Interest Income, Operating
role.documentation: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

role.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity
role.documentation: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

role.label: Interest Income (Expense), Operating and Nonoperating
role.documentation: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating and nonoperating.

role.label: Inventory, Finished Goods, Gross
role.documentation: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of completed merchandise or goods expected to be sold within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

role.label: Inventory, Gross
role.documentation: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, of merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies held for future sale or to be used in manufacturing, servicing or production process.

role.label: Inventory, Net
role.documentation: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

role.label: Inventory, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of inventory accounting policy for inventory classes, including, but not limited to, basis for determining inventory amounts, methods by which amounts are added and removed from inventory classes, loss recognition on impairment of inventories, and situations in which inventories are stated above cost.

role.label: Inventory, Raw Materials, Gross
role.documentation: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of raw materials expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

role.label: Inventory Valuation Reserves
role.documentation: Amount of valuation reserve for inventory.

role.label: Inventory, Work in Process, Gross
role.documentation: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of merchandise or goods in the production process expected to be completed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

role.label: Investment Income, Dividend
role.documentation: Amount of dividend income on nonoperating securities.

role.label: Investment Interest Rate
role.documentation: Rate of interest on investment.

role.label: Investments
role.documentation: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all investments.

role.terseLabel: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates
role.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of investments in and advances to affiliates. Does not include the tabular disclosure of the disaggregation of investments in and advances to affiliates across legal entities.

role.label: Land [Member]
role.documentation: Part of earth's surface not covered by water.

role.label: Lease, Cost
role.documentation: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

role.label: Lease, Cost [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of lessee's lease cost. Includes, but is not limited to, interest expense for finance lease, amortization of right-of-use asset for finance lease, operating lease cost, short-term lease cost, variable lease cost and sublease income.

role.label: Legal Entity [Axis]
role.documentation: The set of legal entities associated with a report.

role.label: Lessee, Lease, Description [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about lessee's leases.

role.label: Lessee, Leases [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for leasing arrangement entered into by lessee.

role.terseLabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due
role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

role.terseLabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due after Year Five
role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.terseLabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Remainder of Fiscal Year
role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Next Rolling 12 Months
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in next rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

role.terseLabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due Year Five
role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.terseLabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due Year Four
role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.terseLabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due Year Three
role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.terseLabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due Year Two
role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.negatedTerseLabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

role.terseLabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Term of Contract
role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Term of Contract
role.documentation: Term of lessee's operating lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Lessee, Operating Leases [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for operating leases of lessee. Includes, but is not limited to, description of operating lease and maturity analysis of operating lease liability.

role.terseLabel: Lessee Operating and Finance Leases Options to Terminate Leases Term
role.label: Lessee Operating and Finance Leases Options to Terminate Leases Term
role.documentation: Lessee Operating and Finance Leases Options to Terminate Leases Term

role.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Renewal Term
role.documentation: Term of lessor's operating lease renewal, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Letter of Credit [Member]
role.documentation: A document typically issued by a financial institution which acts as a guarantee of payment to a beneficiary, or as the source of payment for a specific transaction (for example, wiring funds to a foreign exporter if and when specified merchandise is accepted pursuant to the terms of the letter of credit).

role.label: Liabilities and Equity
role.documentation: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

role.label: Liabilities, Current
role.documentation: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

role.label: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Noncurrent
role.documentation: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as noncurrent.

role.label: Long-Term Line of Credit
role.documentation: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current and noncurrent portions of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

role.terseLabel: Line of Credit Facility, Commitment Fee Percentage
role.label: Line of Credit Facility, Commitment Fee Percentage
role.documentation: The fee, expressed as a percentage of the line of credit facility, for the line of credit facility regardless of whether the facility has been used.

role.terseLabel: Line of credit facility, maximum borrowing capacity
role.label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Borrowing Capacity
role.documentation: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

role.terseLabel: Line of credit facility, accordion feature, increase limit
role.label: Line of Credit Facility, Accordion Feature, Increase Limit
role.documentation: Line of Credit Facility, Accordion Feature, Increase Limit

role.label: Local Phone Number
role.documentation: Local phone number for entity.

role.label: Long-Term Debt
role.documentation: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

role.label: Long-Term Debt, by Type, Current and Noncurrent [Abstract]
Long-Term Debt, Current Maturities
role.documentation: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

role.terseLabel: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal, Remainder of Fiscal Year
role.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year One
role.documentation: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.terseLabel: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Five
role.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Five
